name: chainlib
description: Decentralized e-library platform on Stellar blockchain

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:contracts
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:contracts
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:contracts
scripts.format: npm run format:backend && npm run format:frontend && npm run format:contracts
scripts.setup: npm run setup:frontend && npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:contracts
scripts.deploy:contracts:testnet: cd contracts/chainlib-contracts && soroban contract deploy --wasm target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/chainlib.wasm --source alice --network testnet
scripts.deploy:contracts:mainnet: cd contracts/chainlib-contracts && soroban contract deploy --wasm target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/chainlib.wasm --source alice --network mainnet
scripts.audit: npm run audit:backend && npm run audit:frontend && npm run audit:contracts
scripts.docs: npm run docs:backend && npm run docs:contracts
scripts.clean: npm run clean:backend && npm run clean:frontend && npm run clean:contracts

author: ChainLib Team
